scripts.local: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail  "vite --mode development " "nodemon --watch server/ --exec 'npm run build:server && NODE_ENV=development-local NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 node dist/server/server.js'"
scripts.local-veileder: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail  "vite --mode development-veileder " "nodemon --watch server/ --exec 'npm run build:server && NODE_ENV=development-local NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 node dist/server/server.js'"
scripts.debug: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "vite --mode development" "nodemon --watch server/ --ext ts,js --exec 'npm run build:server && NODE_ENV=development-local NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 node --inspect-brk=9229 dist/server/server.js'"
scripts.q2: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail  "vite --mode development " "nodemon --watch server/ --exec 'npm run build:server && NODE_ENV=development NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 node dist/server/server.js'"
scripts.q2-veileder: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail  "vite --mode development-veileder " "nodemon --watch server/ --exec 'npm run build:server && NODE_ENV=development NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 node dist/server/server.js'"
scripts.build: tsc && vite build --mode development && npm run build:server
scripts.build:development:veileder: tsc && vite build --mode development-veileder && npm run build:server
scripts.build:production: tsc && vite build && npm run build:server
scripts.build:production:veileder: tsc && vite build --mode production-veileder && npm run build:server
